description: 한국전력공사_전기차 충전소 운영 정보 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국전력공사. 한국전력공사에서 제공하고 있는 전력데이터개방포털내 API로 제공되고 있는 전기차 충전소 운영정보 데이터 입니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국전력공사. Its tags are 전기차충전, 전기차, 충전소, 충전소정보, 운영정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-08-22 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
